teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: father, mother, parents, brother, sister, son, daughter, children, grandfather, grandmother, grandparents

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
father, mother, parents, brother, sister, son, daughter, children, grandfather, grandmother, grandparents
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• This is my father (introducing family)
• I have two brothers (stating siblings)
• Meet my family (introducing relatives)
• Who is this? (asking identity)
Pronunciation Focus:
Voiced and voiceless 'th' sound in 'father', 'brother', 'mother' (/ð/).

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Possessive Adjectives & Possessive 's (my, your, his, her, John's father)

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Possessive Adjectives & Possessive 's (my, your, his, her, John's father)
Controlled Practice:
Who is your father's sister?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Who is this in the photo?
B: This is my father, John, and my mother, Mary.
A: Do you have brothers or sisters?
B: Yes, I have one brother and two sisters.
Listen to Mark presenting his family album and identify his siblings and grandparents.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Practice speaking with your partner: I can name immediate and extended family members and describe my family tree.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can name immediate and extended family members and describe my family tree.
Write 3-5 sentences in your workbook applying today's target phrases.
Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow: 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Family vocab & Tree; 25-40m Possessives & 's; 40-55m Speaking Pair Roleplay; 55-60m Wrap-up.
• 90m Flow: Add 15m 5-step Vocab Drill and 15m Writing practice.
• 120m Flow: Full workshop with group family tree project and presentations.

teacherNotes.title: Individual Adaptation
teacherNotes.content: Direct 1-on-1 practice, immediate feedback on 'th' sound (/ð/ in father/brother), and personalized family tree creation.

teacherNotes.title: Group Adaptation
teacherNotes.content: Pair family tree interviews and speed-mingle roleplay introduced to classmates.
